summary: Decompose a specification and design into bounded, dependency-aware work units.

inputs.name: specification
inputs.description: Behavior, acceptance criteria, scope, and quality constraints.

inputs.name: solution-design
inputs.description: Chosen structure, interfaces, and rollout constraints.

inputs.name: project-context
inputs.description: Available verification paths and ownership constraints.

completion_checks: Every in-scope acceptance criterion is assigned to verifiable work.
Dependencies form an acyclic graph with a usable ready frontier.
Integration ownership, verification, and stop conditions are explicit.
failure_modes: The design leaves a prerequisite decision unresolved: blocked for dependent work.
A proposed decomposition cannot be verified within its stated bounds: inconclusive.
